newsitem.title: GHANA: Ashanti drags down Ghana stock indices.
newsitem.headline: Ashanti drags down Ghana stock indices.

text.p: Market heavyweight Ashanti Goldfields dragged dragged down the Ghana Stock Exchange's All-Share Index on Monday, with dealers blaming Ashanti's fall on its performance on other markets where it is quoted.
The All-Share Index fell 1.54 points to 365.89 points from Friday's 367.43. Ashanti slipped 700 cedis to 25,000 cedis in very thin volume of 5,030 shares changing hands.

"AGC price on the local market is linked to other international markets like the London and New York stock exchanges, therefore any hiccoughs on these bourses are quickly reflected here," one dealer said.
Gold was fixed in London at $375.10 per ounce on Monday morning, its lowest since March 2 1995.
Guinness Ghana (-2 cedis to 242 cedis) and Mobil Oil Ghana (+100 cedis to 6,000) were the other two movers on Ghana's exchange on Monday.
Shares offered exceeded demand by 822,640 to 614,030.
